title: UAE Flood Damage Costs and Frequency (2015-2024)
executive_question: How have flood damage costs and frequency evolved in the UAE over the past decade?
required_metrics: Annual flood damage cost in USD (2015-2024)
Annual number of flood events (2015-2024)
Annual rainfall in mm (2015-2024)
comparison_set: Yearly data points for each metric
preferred_sources: UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment
Insurance industry reports (e.g., Swiss Re, Munich Re)
data_quality_rule: Use official government or insurance data. If annual data is incomplete, use at least 4 data points and mark missing years as estimates based on linear interpolation or CAGR.
narrative_role: Establishes the urgency and escalating trend of flood risk in the UAE, supporting the thesis that smart drainage is no longer optional.
pre_exhibit_context: The report claims that the UAE's flood risk is escalating due to climate change and urbanization, but needs data to prove it.
post_exhibit_takeaway: The upward trend in flood damage costs and frequency confirms the growing threat, justifying investment in smart drainage.
